products.name: Descript Overdub
products.note: Voice cloning for editing; consent recording required; deepfake risk; media integrity

profile_text.body:
Descript is a for-profit startup founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as an AI video and audio editor built around text-based editing: users record or upload footage, the platform's AI transcribes it, and edits to the transcript, such as deleting a word or moving a sentence, translate directly into changes to the underlying video or audio. The tool is marketed as supporting the full production cycle, from recording and transcription through to publishing, in a single application.

The platform's AI products include a general editing environment under the Descript name and two distinct AI-powered features. Underlord is described on the site as an AI video editor that can turn a raw recording into a finished cut by following user instructions. Descript Overdub is a voice cloning product that allows users to generate audio in their own voice for editing purposes; the held facts note that consent recording is required and flag deepfake risk and media integrity as relevant concerns for that feature.

The site's held facts record 139 legal exposure entries linked to California, though no specific cases are listed. Descript does not appear in the MCP server registry, and no SEC or patent filings are noted in the available data.
